# SEC EDGAR schema

Generated from the `sec` mapper; do not edit by hand. Regenerate with `cargo run -p blocks --example dump_schemas` (see [README](README.md) for the conventions).

- Block type: `--block-type sec`.
- Byte encoding: `hex` (lowercase hex with a `0x` prefix), fixed for this chain in v1.0.0.
- Columns typed `string` (hex) hold binary values written as text in that encoding.
- `fork_step` and `stream_ordinal` are listed where they sit on non-final streams (`--final-blocks-only=false`); with the default `--final-blocks-only=true` they are absent.
- Types are the Delta types of the data files; [Delta type mapping](#delta-type-mapping) lists how each mapper column gets its type.
- `block_id` and `parent_id` are decimal 10-minute window numbers (`"2984687"`, `block_num = unix_seconds / 600`), written verbatim, not hashes. A feed day has 144 windows, empty ones included: every window has a `blocks` row.
- Amounts are typed decimals in five `decimal(38,s)` scale families (M2 = 2, Q6 = 6, N10 = 10, R12 = 12, S16 = 16), dates are `date`, and XSD integers are `integer` or `long`. Every source value that a typed column does not reproduce exactly (unparseable, sentinel, out of range, rounded, dropped time zone, overflow) has one `parse_issues` row with the verbatim text, and its row has `has_parse_issues`.
- Rows are keyed `(block_num, filing_index[, child positions])`. `accession_number` is not unique, because EDGAR re-disseminates filings: use the `sec_filings_first` view.
- 13F `value` is raw (thousands before 2023-01-03, dollars after, with filer exceptions): use the `sec_13f_holdings_usd` view.

## `blocks`

One row per 10-minute window. The only table with a row for empty windows; commits last.

| Column | Type | Nullable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `block_num` | `long` | no | Block number (Firehose block metadata). |
| `block_id` | `string` (hex) | no | Block id (hash), in the chain's byte encoding. |
| `parent_num` | `long` | no | Parent block number (Firehose block metadata). |
| `parent_id` | `string` (hex) | no | Parent block id, in the chain's byte encoding. |
| `lib_num` | `long` | no | Last irreversible block number reported with the block. |
| `timestamp` | `timestamp` | no | Block time, UTC, millisecond precision (stored in microseconds). |
| `date` | `date` (partition) | no | Partition column: the UTC date of the block time, stored in the Delta log (`partitionValues.date`) and the `date=YYYY-MM-DD` directory, not in the data files. |
| `feed_date` | `date` | yes | `Block.header.feed_date`: date (§4.2). The producer's feed day; equal to the `date` partition by construction. |
| `filing_count` | `long` | no | Derived from `Block.filings[]`: length of the list. 0 for ~39% of windows. |
| `has_parse_issues` | `boolean` | no | Derived: true iff this row wrote ≥1 `parse_issues` row (§4.6). |
| `fork_step` | `string` | no | **Non-final streams only** (`--final-blocks-only=false`): the Firehose fork step of the block, `NEW`, `UNDO` or `FINAL`. |
| `stream_ordinal` | `long` | no | **Non-final streams only** (`--final-blocks-only=false`): accepted-event ordinal of the stream event (`NEW`, `UNDO` or `FINAL`) that produced the row. Strictly increasing in delivery order and durable across reconnects and restarts; every row of one event, in every table, has the same value. |

## `filings`

One row per filing: the envelope, resolved parties and dissemination flags. Every other table joins here on `(block_num, filing_index)`.

| Column | Type | Nullable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `block_num` | `long` | no | Block number (Firehose block metadata). |
| `block_id` | `string` (hex) | no | Block id (hash), in the chain's byte encoding. |
| `parent_num` | `long` | no | Parent block number (Firehose block metadata). |
| `parent_id` | `string` (hex) | no | Parent block id, in the chain's byte encoding. |
| `lib_num` | `long` | no | Last irreversible block number reported with the block. |
| `timestamp` | `timestamp` | no | Block time, UTC, millisecond precision (stored in microseconds). |
| `date` | `date` (partition) | no | Partition column: the UTC date of the block time, stored in the Delta log (`partitionValues.date`) and the `date=YYYY-MM-DD` directory, not in the data files. |
| `filing_index` | `long` | no | `Filing.ordinal`: u32::try_from (overflow = structural error, §4.7). With `block_num`, the filing key. |
| `accession_number` | `string` | no | `Filing.accession_number`: verbatim. EDGAR id; NOT unique across blocks (re-dissemination). |
| `form_type` | `string` | no | `Filing.form_type`: verbatim (always present). `4`, `13F-HR/A`, `SCHEDULE 13G`, … (26 values in the sample). |
| `base_form_type` | `string` | no | Derived from `Filing.form_type`: form_type with one trailing `/A` removed. Groups originals with their amendments. |
| `is_amendment` | `boolean` | no | `Filing.is_amendment`: proto bool (false = false or absent). = form_type ends with `/A` (100% in the sample). |
| `body_kind` | `string` | yes | `Filing.body (oneof)`: name of the populated `body` member. `ownership` `form13f` `beneficial` `raw` `form144` `nport` `form_d` `npx` `ncen` `form_c`; NULL if unset (never seen). |
| `cik` | `string` | yes | `Filing.cik`. Header party CIK (10-pad); its party is named by `cik_role`. |
| `cik_role` | `string` | yes | `Filing.cik_role`. `ISSUER` (3/4/5), `SUBJECT-COMPANY` (13D/G, 144), `FILER` (13F, N-PORT, N-PX, N-CEN, D, C). |
| `company_name` | `string` | yes | `Filing.company_name`. Conformed name of the `cik` party. |
| `issuer_cik` | `string` | yes | Derived from `Filing.parties[]`: party rule (§4.5). Company the filing is about; NULL for 13F/N-PORT/N-PX/N-CEN. |
| `issuer_name` | `string` | yes | Derived from `Filing.parties[]`: party rule (§4.5). |
| `filer_cik` | `string` | yes | Derived from `Filing.parties[]`: party rule (§4.5). First REPORTING-OWNER / FILED-BY / FILER party (header order). |
| `filer_name` | `string` | yes | Derived from `Filing.parties[]`: party rule (§4.5). |
| `filing_date` | `date` | yes | `Filing.filing_date`: date (§4.2). Legal filing date; can be years before `date` (re-dissemination). |
| `period_of_report` | `date` | yes | `Filing.period_of_report`: date (§4.2). Absent on 144, D, C, 13D/G. |
| `acceptance_datetime` | `timestamp` | yes | `Filing.acceptance_datetime`: protobuf Timestamp → ms (checked; out of range = structural error). EDGAR acceptance (UTC, whole seconds); may fall outside the block window. |
| `acceptance_in_block_window` | `boolean` | yes | Derived from `Filing.acceptance_datetime`: `timestamp ≤ acceptance_datetime < timestamp + 10 min`; NULL if acceptance NULL. False for the ~5% clamped into window 0 or 143. |
| `dissemination_lag_days` | `integer` | yes | Derived from `Filing.filing_date`: `date − filing_date` in days; NULL if filing_date NULL. 0–4 normally; years for re-disseminated filings. |
| `primary_document` | `string` | yes | `Filing.primary_document`. First `.xml` document, not necessarily SEC's primary document. |
| `amended_accession` | `string` | yes | `Filing.amended_accession`. Accession this amendment amends (Form D/A, 13D/G/A, 144/A, N-CEN/A); NULL otherwise. |
| `source_path` | `string` | yes | `Filing.source_path`. `<feed>.gz!<accession>`. |
| `dissemination_flags` | `array<string>` | no | `Filing.dissemination_flags[]`: verbatim items in document order; [] when empty. `CORRECTION`, `DELETION`, `PAPER`, `CONFIRMING-COPY`, `PRIVATE-TO-PUBLIC`. |
| `dissemination_timestamp` | `string` | yes | `Filing.dissemination_timestamp`. Raw `YYYYMMDD:HHMMSS`, US-Eastern; not typed (§4.2). |
| `is_deletion_notice` | `boolean` | no | Derived from `Filing.dissemination_flags[]`: `DELETION` ∈ dissemination_flags. EDGAR notice that `accession_number` was deleted; body is `raw` with reason `deletion`. |
| `group_members` | `array<string>` | no | `Filing.group_members[]`: verbatim items in document order; [] when empty. Legacy SC 13D/G `<GROUP-MEMBERS>` lines. |
| `party_count` | `long` | no | Derived from `Filing.parties[]`: length of the list. |
| `document_count` | `long` | no | Derived from `Filing.documents[]`: length of the list. |
| `series_count` | `long` | no | Derived from `Filing.series[]`: length of the list. |
| `raw_reason` | `string` | yes | `Filing.body.raw.reason`. `no_xml`, `legacy_html`, `parse_error`, `deletion`, `unsupported_form`; NULL unless body_kind = `raw`. |
| `raw_detail` | `string` | yes | `Filing.body.raw.detail`. Parser message for `parse_error`. |
| `has_raw_xml` | `boolean` | no | Derived from `Filing.raw_xml`: `raw_xml` non-empty. The filing has a `filing_raw_xml` row. |
| `raw_xml_size` | `long` | no | Derived from `Filing.raw_xml`: byte length of `raw_xml` (0 without `--include-raw`). |
| `has_parse_issues` | `boolean` | no | Derived: true iff this row wrote ≥1 `parse_issues` row (§4.6). |
| `fork_step` | `string` | no | **Non-final streams only** (`--final-blocks-only=false`): the Firehose fork step of the block, `NEW`, `UNDO` or `FINAL`. |
| `stream_ordinal` | `long` | no | **Non-final streams only** (`--final-blocks-only=false`): accepted-event ordinal of the stream event (`NEW`, `UNDO` or `FINAL`) that produced the row. Strictly increasing in delivery order and durable across reconnects and restarts; every row of one event, in every table, has the same value. |

| `signed_shares` | `decimal(38,6)` | yes | Derived from `shares, acquired_disposed_code`: `shares` × (+1 for A, −1 for D); NULL otherwise. Net buying without CASE. |
| `value_usd` | `decimal(38,6)` | yes | Derived from `shares, price_per_share`: `shares × price_per_share` exact in i128, rounded half away from zero to s=6; NULL if either is NULL. Trade value; NULL (never 0) for footnote-only prices. |
| `is_open_market` | `boolean` | no | Derived: `NOT is_derivative AND transaction_code IN (P, S)`. The standard insider buy/sell filter; per the SEC code legend `S` is "open market **or private** sale". |
| `filing_lag_days` | `integer` | yes | Derived: `filing_date − transaction_date` in days. Form 4 is due within 2 business days. |
| `has_parse_issues` | `boolean` | no | Derived: true iff this row wrote ≥1 `parse_issues` row (§4.6). |
| `fork_step` | `string` | no | **Non-final streams only** (`--final-blocks-only=false`): the Firehose fork step of the block, `NEW`, `UNDO` or `FINAL`. |
| `stream_ordinal` | `long` | no | **Non-final streams only** (`--final-blocks-only=false`): accepted-event ordinal of the stream event (`NEW`, `UNDO` or `FINAL`) that produced the row. Strictly increasing in delivery order and durable across reconnects and restarts; every row of one event, in every table, has the same value. |

## `parse_issues`

Every source value that did not convert exactly (or was rounded), with enough keys to put it back on its row. No files on clean days.

| Column | Type | Nullable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `block_num` | `long` | no | Block number (Firehose block metadata). |
| `block_id` | `string` (hex) | no | Block id (hash), in the chain's byte encoding. |
| `parent_num` | `long` | no | Parent block number (Firehose block metadata). |
| `parent_id` | `string` (hex) | no | Parent block id, in the chain's byte encoding. |
| `lib_num` | `long` | no | Last irreversible block number reported with the block. |
| `timestamp` | `timestamp` | no | Block time, UTC, millisecond precision (stored in microseconds). |
| `date` | `date` (partition) | no | Partition column: the UTC date of the block time, stored in the Delta log (`partitionValues.date`) and the `date=YYYY-MM-DD` directory, not in the data files. |
| `filing_index` | `long` | yes | `Filing.ordinal`: the filing of the value; NULL for block-level fields (`blocks.feed_date`). |
| `accession_number` | `string` | yes | `Filing.accession_number`: verbatim; NULL for block-level fields. |
| `table_name` | `string` | no | Derived: table of the typed column. |
| `column_name` | `string` | no | Derived: typed column; `list.member` for a List<Struct> member (`former_names.date_changed`). |
| `index_1` | `long` | yes | Derived: first key position after `filing_index` (§4.6). |
| `index_2` | `long` | yes | Derived: second key position. |
| `index_3` | `long` | yes | Derived: third key position. |
| `raw_value` | `string` | no | The source string: verbatim; for `overflow`, the operands joined with ` * ` / ` + ` (§4.6). |
| `issue` | `string` | no | Derived: `unparseable`, `sentinel`, `out_of_range`, `rounded`, `tz_dropped`, `overflow` (§4.6). |
| `fork_step` | `string` | no | **Non-final streams only** (`--final-blocks-only=false`): the Firehose fork step of the block, `NEW`, `UNDO` or `FINAL`. |
| `stream_ordinal` | `long` | no | **Non-final streams only** (`--final-blocks-only=false`): accepted-event ordinal of the stream event (`NEW`, `UNDO` or `FINAL`) that produced the row. Strictly increasing in delivery order and durable across reconnects and restarts; every row of one event, in every table, has the same value. |

## Delta type mapping

The mapper builds Arrow types; every flush maps them onto the Delta types above once, with checked casts, before anything is written (#643, `firehose_parquet::delta::types`). Columns that are not listed are built with their Delta type. A column is listed with its tables unless every table has it (`stream_ordinal` on non-final streams only).

| Mapper Arrow type | Delta type | Conversion | Columns |
|---|---|---|---|
| `UInt64` | `long` | checked: a value above 9,223,372,036,854,775,807 (`i64::MAX`) refuses the flush before anything is written | `block_num`; `parent_num`; `lib_num`; `stream_ordinal` |
| `UInt32` | `long` | lossless | `filing_count` (`blocks`); `filing_index` (every table but `blocks`); `party_count` (`filings`); `document_count` (`filings`); `series_count` (`filings`, `ncen_reports`); `raw_xml_size` (`filings`); `party_index` (`filing_parties`); `document_index` (`filing_documents`); `series_index` (`filing_series`, `filing_series_classes`); `class_count` (`filing_series`); `class_index` (`filing_series_classes`); `signature_index` (`filing_signatures`); `reporting_owner_count` (`ownership_documents`, `ownership_transactions`, `ownership_holdings`); `non_derivative_transaction_count` (`ownership_documents`); `derivative_transaction_count` (`ownership_documents`); `non_derivative_holding_count` (`ownership_documents`); `derivative_holding_count` (`ownership_documents`, `nport_reports`); `footnote_count` (`ownership_documents`); `owner_signature_count` (`ownership_documents`); `owner_index` (`ownership_reporting_owners`); `transaction_index` (`ownership_transactions`); `holding_index` (`ownership_holdings`, `form13f_holdings`, `nport_holdings`, `nport_debt_reference_instruments`, `nport_debt_conversion_currencies`, `nport_derivatives`, `nport_derivative_swap_legs`, `nport_derivative_index_components`); `footnote_index` (`ownership_footnotes`); `other_included_managers_count` (`form13f_reports`); `table_entry_total` (`form13f_reports`); `holdings_count` (`form13f_reports`, `nport_reports`); `cover_other_manager_count` (`form13f_reports`); `summary_other_manager_count` (`form13f_reports`); `other_manager_index` (`form13f_other_managers`, `npx_other_managers`); `reporting_person_count` (`beneficial_reports`); `signature_count` (`beneficial_reports`); `person_index` (`beneficial_reporting_persons`, `form_d_related_persons`); `securities_information_count` (`form144_notices`); `securities_to_be_sold_count` (`form144_notices`); `sales_past_3_months_count` (`form144_notices`); `entry_index` (`form144_securities_information`); `lot_index` (`form144_securities_to_be_sold`); `sale_index` (`form144_sales_past_3_months`); `debt_holding_count` (`nport_reports`); `monthly_return_class_count` (`nport_reports`); `return_index` (`nport_monthly_returns`); `activity_index` (`nport_monthly_activity`); `month` (`nport_monthly_activity`); `debt_reference_instrument_count` (`nport_holdings`); `debt_conversion_currency_count` (`nport_holdings`); `reference_index` (`nport_debt_reference_instruments`); `conversion_index` (`nport_debt_conversion_currencies`); `nesting_level` (`nport_derivatives`, `nport_derivative_swap_legs`, `nport_derivative_index_components`); `swap_leg_count` (`nport_derivatives`); `index_component_count` (`nport_derivatives`); `leg_index` (`nport_derivative_swap_legs`); `component_index` (`nport_derivative_index_components`); `co_issuer_count` (`form_d_notices`, `form_c_notices`); `related_person_count` (`form_d_notices`); `sales_recipient_count` (`form_d_notices`); `co_issuer_index` (`form_d_co_issuers`, `form_c_co_issuers`); `recipient_index` (`form_d_sales_recipients`); `vote_count` (`npx_reports`); `vote_record_count` (`npx_reports`); `other_manager_count` (`npx_reports`); `vote_index` (`npx_votes`, `npx_vote_records`); `record_count` (`npx_votes`); `record_index` (`npx_vote_records`); `index_1` (`parse_issues`); `index_2` (`parse_issues`); `index_3` (`parse_issues`) |
| `Dictionary(Int32, Utf8)` | `string` | the same labels; Parquet still dictionary-encodes the pages | `body_kind` (`filings`); `signature_source` (`filing_signatures`); `list_kind` (`form13f_other_managers`, `npx_other_managers`); `put_call_norm` (`form13f_holdings`); `schedule_kind` (`beneficial_reports`, `beneficial_reporting_persons`); `table_name` (`parse_issues`); `column_name` (`parse_issues`); `issue` (`parse_issues`) |
| `Timestamp(Millisecond, "UTC")` | `timestamp` | the same instant, stored as `TIMESTAMP(MICROS, UTC)` (whole milliseconds) | `timestamp`; `acceptance_datetime` (every table but `blocks` and `parse_issues`) |
| `date` column (`Date32`) | partition column | stored in the Delta log (`partitionValues.date`) and the `date=YYYY-MM-DD` directory, not in the data files | `date` |

### `decimal(20,0)` columns

The `UInt64` columns stored as `decimal(20,0)` instead of a checked `long` (`ChainProfile::decimal_columns` in `blocks/src/chain.rs`). Every other `UInt64` column is bounded by its protocol.

None: every `UInt64` column of this chain is a checked `long`.
